data.one_liner: Generate ESC/POS commands to print via Bluetooth, Network, or USB thermal printers.
data.what_it_does: Generates ESC/POS byte commands for thermal printers. It provides helper classes for text styling, tables, images, barcodes, QR codes, and paper control operations.
use_when: You need to build receipt tickets for thermal POS printers.
You want to format text, tables, and images into raw printer bytes.
avoid_when: You are printing standard documents to non-thermal office printers.
strengths: Supports multiple paper sizes and various code tables.
Handles complex ticket elements like tables, barcodes, and images.
weaknesses: Printer feature support varies heavily by hardware model.
Does not handle the physical connection transport layer directly.
